svg.title: Unlimited packing
svg.desc: The bytes 0x48 0x69 as one bit stream cut into packages of 8, 4 and 3 bits between START and STOP markers, computed with the Encoder.
svg.text: From bytes to packages: “Hi” with N = 8, 4 and 3
Computed with the Encoder (Encoder::status() per slot); the bytes are one stream of bits, MSB first, cut into N-bit packages.
◆ = a marker (the beep with the twist): the last sync marker is the first START, every STOP is the next START, END = 2 markers.
2 packages: 16 bits + 2 STOPs = 18 slots; the whole transmission 44 slots, 804 ms with hf timing
4 packages: 16 bits + 4 STOPs = 20 slots; the whole transmission 46 slots, 836 ms with hf timing
6 packages (the last one 1 bit): 16 bits + 6 STOPs = 22 slots; the whole transmission 48 slots, 868 ms with hf timing
A byte may span packages (N = 3: package 2 carries the last two bits of 'H' and the first of 'i'); the receiver puts the bits back by package index.
The last package holds only the bits left, never padding; its STOP and the 2 END markers are 3 markers in a row, which only an end can give.
